name: diy-outdoor-blinds-landing
description: Static landing page, pre-built in diyoutdoorblinds.com.au/. The build step publishes it to the repo root and to dist/ so the host finds index.html whatever output directory it is set to.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && cp -R diyoutdoorblinds.com.au dist && cp -R diyoutdoorblinds.com.au/. .
